default.rule: the largest featured fire the world model never saw (MODIS pixels in the box at its busiest start); while the standings are not served, the largest featured fire that is not a blind test fire; inside the warm region (places.json warm_region), by the rule above
default.chosen_by: the world model's standing, inside the warm region (places.json warm_region), by the rule above

not_offered: presets with no FIRMS rows are kept for the tests and not offered: no path of the page may lead to a simulated fire
featured_fires_rule: periods of the starts the start search marks busiest, less than 31 days apart, largest first by MODIS pixels in the box at the busiest start; named from places.json when a named fire's dates overlap and its point lies within 0.5 degrees of the region's box
standing: to_the_world_model and to_the_learned_agent say whether that part was fitted on the fire, validated on it, had it as a recorded test fire, or never saw it, and closed whether a held-out run, round or play of it is refused (backend.model.fire_roles.fire_roles; null in a build without it)
named_fires_from: Named fires of each region: the name, dates, burned area and point the page in source gives (point_source, area_source or last_day_source when that fact comes from another page). They name the featured fires, which are chosen by rule from the real run starts, and give a calendar box around each fire; the rows and every figure of a calendar or a run come from NASA FIRMS. last_day is null where no end date is published.

box_calendar.what: any box with rows in a cached FIRMS country file; rows outside those countries are not counted
